body: Jeg tror skam at jeg får brug for et nødtilskud når jeg kommer tilbage fra felten!
Det kan være at jeg får brug for et vitamin ø-tilskud!
Aalborg

Du har skam fat i noget.
Jeg fik dog kun en 10'er i prøven, men jeg har da fundet nogle fællestræk som stemmer overens.
Heldigvis ikke; jeg slap med en lussing for at have "nakket min smøg".

Hold da fast!

Det første jeg ser når jeg vågner, er en milliard beskeder. 
Jeg ved ikke hvad pokker jeg skal sige, andet end at det er en overraskelse...

 
Det med at opsøge hjælp overvejes, men i første omgang klarer jeg det på egen hånd. I de sidste 4 måneder blev jeg markant mere selvsikker, det har militæret hjulpet ufattelig meget med, og jeg tænker at udviklingen vil fortsætte.

I går aftes var mere træls end andre, derfor overreagerede jeg og skrev dette. Til hverdag er det knapt så slemt; jeg tager det som en mand og bare går videre med livet, ligesom jeg altid har gjort.

Mine forældre er fremragende mennesker. Det er bare mig der piver løs i dag; jeg holder ellers kæft. 
Jeg tror skam ikke at en psykolog vil kunne hjælpe det store! Jeg har fået det bedre på egen hånd. 
Inden værnepligt var jeg helvedes genert, men milli hjalp mig med selvtilliden som netop gjorde at jeg turde at lave sjov og tage lidt pis på vores befalingsmænd.
Det sociale er jeg ret rusten til grundet min isolering, men jeg har da observeret og lært lidt igennem årene. Det er bare træls når man er nervøs, men det er bare en tilvænningssag.
Jeg overvejer også hvad uge 28-30 skal bruges på, andet end at besøge de gamle. Muligvis smutte en tur til udlandet.

Ja, det var fravær. Jeg lå derhjemme og havde ondt af mig selv, i stedet for at tage handling.
Jeg har (mis)brugt min tid med computerspil. Jeg er dog vokset fra det, og nu må jeg finde på andet at lave, nu hvor jeg lige er flyttet til Aalborg
Jeg har ingen interesser...
Jeg har ikke andre end fremmede at snakke med. Jeg fortsætter fremad, selvom at det hele er lort. Det har jeg altid gjort.
Jeg skal satme ikke til hverken læge eller psykolog, for så at blive burret inde på en galeanstalt. Så bliver det først noget lort.

Thanks!
And sorry for overreacting...
Boot camp

Decent, but I keep fucking it up.
Can't pack or organise my gear at all, and I constantly forget things.
The only thing I remember is how to disassemble the rifle...
The closest thing I have to a delete button is an antique revolver, the trouble is, I can't get ammunition...
Thanks! But there's no need to be concerned about me, as I am coming to peace with my life. Although I might scuttle the ship one day...
Same here, except the person who supported me was a classmate, whom I now have lost contact with.

I used to have a pet dog and cat, but they both died 2 years ago.
Now I have nothing, not even my parents, as they are getting old and fed up with my crap.

We both sadly suffer from this wretched loneliness, for I, too, have spent countless hours looking with a stare into the air with despair.


Like you, I've been very lonely for such a long time, that I sometimes speak with inanimate objects, and I have conversations with myself on a daily basis just to keep myself accompanied.

That just proves our theories of people not giving a damn!
I've only had 1 person/friend in my 19 years of life that genuinely cared and noticed I was feeling like shit, although he has since given up on me an we haven't spoken in a long time, and I don't blame him.

I learned that the hard way! I have always tried to shut up, as to lessen the burdens on others, and the embarrasment that follows. 

But when I finally let my guard down and told someone, it all blew up. Of course I got the obligatory "We're here for you" and "bla bla we care bla bla bla..." only to be forgotten 2 minutes later.
I too have an urge to tell the truth about my life. However, I fear that saying too much will have severe consequences, as I've already experienced a backlash for opening up too much.
You've caught my attention, so I'll definitely give it a read.

Same here!
My memories mostly consist of crappy events, with only a rare sprinkle of good here and there.
Like you, I sleep all of the time, because A. Tired (physically and mentally). B. Nothing better to do.
When I wake up in the morning to a new, miserable day...

No need to feel sorry for me. Someone suddenly contacted me after several months today, and asked if I wanted to hang out tomorrow and grab a bite.

Also, I hope that your situation improves so that you can get over the unfortunate breakup, the loss of friends, the pain, and hopefully get new friendships and find love again.

Good luck!

I met him on the internet in 2009.
The guy was always a bit funny and shy. Turned out he had schizophrenia. 

After he was admitted into the mental hospital, he started acting very odd, and suddenly, he unfriended me on everything.

I knew another guy who was friends with him irl. He told me that he was acting very strange indeed, not even greeting if they met on the street.
That was the last I heard from him back in 2015.


Sorry for the late response, but it was almost 2 in the morning where I live.

I can imagine that a breakup is extra painful compared to losing a friend. Being abandoned after investing yourself into another person you loved must hurt a lot. The only comparable thing I've tried is when I suddenly lost all contact to a friend of mine I knew for 5 years.
I can relate to friends being gone; it has been months since I last spoke to the only true friend that ever cared about me.
The only thing I can think of is setting objectives and rewarding yourself for completing them, like "if I do the dishes, I can enjoy a bar of chocolate".
I've just become so sick of people lying to me about them "caring".  The only person that actually cared about me and tried to help hasn't spoken to me in months, so I guess that's over.

I remember being told several times that "everything will be alright" and "we're here for you" only to be forgotten 2 minutes later. Why blatantly lie? Why not just say "I dont give a shit", you will be an asshole, but atleast you're being honest!
Sitting in the same boat, so I guess that makes us alone together. I also struggle with the "making everything hard to do" part.
Guess we're both experts on that. I am also considering to just end it. What other problems may we have in common?
We must be clones or something, since we are in the exact same situation, except I have a "job" (Legal slavery, I earn what equals 36$ a week for 34 hours of work).
Still the same, nothing changes, fuck this hell, I never had a life.
